text:
maria_sales: Hey @aj_cs — handing off Sable (acct: SBL-73). Signed last week, kickoff scheduled. Quick summary below.

maria_sales: Contract signed, TCV $48k/yr. They want a private (VPC) deployment + SSO. Primary use: CS automation + embeddings for KB.

aj_cs: Thanks Maria. Pushed the initial handoff doc to the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/SBL-73 — please keep notes there.

aj_cs: Current status: kickoff call set for Mon Apr 3 @10am PT. Internal enablement assigned to @andy_success_engineer.

andy_success_engineer: I'll run the SSO + ingest workshop. Need their IdP metadata and a list of initial prompt templates.

maria_sales: They said IdP is Okta, will share metadata by EOD Wed. They also want to ingest Zendesk KB — ~250k docs total, but start with top 20k.

aj_cs: Risk note: renewal horizon ~11 months. Customer flagged cost sensitivity — mark renewal_risk: medium until we lock unit economics (batching/quant).

aj_cs: Blockers: private deployment requires network review and KMS confirmation. @lisa_eng can you advise on expected timeline once we have peering info?

lisa_eng: Network review ETA ~3 business days after we get VPC peering info + firewall rules. Also need KMS provider details (ARN).

maria_sales: They use AWS KMS. I'll get the key ARN and Okta metadata by Wed EOD.

kevin_support: Heads-up: older Zendesk exports sometimes hit a schema mismatch in our importer. If they send a sample export I can pre-validate.

aj_cs: Action items (I'll add to the doc):
- maria_sales: Provide Okta metadata + KMS ARN by Wed EOD (owner: maria_sales)
- andy_success_engineer: Schedule SSO + ingest workshop after metadata received (owner: andy_success_engineer)
- lisa_eng: Run network/KMS review once peering info available (owner: lisa_eng)
- kevin_support: Validate Zendesk export sample once provided (owner: kevin_support)
Due date for initial prod-ready target: Apr 24.

andy_success_engineer: I'll build a short enablement deck and starter prompt template pack.

maria_sales: Also flagged: customer worried about latency for EU users (they have EU office). Primary infra in us-west-2. Could be a routing policy request later.

lisa_eng: Noted. We'll include EU route options (eu-central inference) in the network review and estimate cost/latency tradeoffs.

kevin_support: If import fails I'll escalate to @lisa_eng with logs. Example error we see sometimes:
```
ERROR: embedding pipeline failed at transform step: KeyError 'attachment'
```
aj_cs: Good plan. I'll update the shared handoff doc and tag owners. @maria_sales please post confirmations as you get Okta + KMS ARN. :thumbsup:

maria_sales: Will do. Thanks everyone.

oncall-bot: Reminder: kickoff call scheduled Mon Apr 3 17:00 UTC.
